headline: INDIA DOUBLES Gold, Silver Import Duties to 15% — PM Modi Urges Nation to Stop Buying
snippet: India doubled import taxes on gold and silver to 15% from 6% effective May 13, citing a weakening rupee and the Iran war's drain on foreign exchange reserves. PM Modi publicly urged citizens to pause gold purchases for one year — a move industry officials warn could revive smuggling that had eased since 2024. The world's second-largest gold consumer pulling back is a fresh demand headwind hitting prices already under pressure from hot CPI data.

headline: USAR BEATS Q1 Estimates at $5.7M Revenue; Stillwater Phase 1 Live, $1.6B CHIPS Funding in Sight
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) reported Q1 revenue of $5.7M, topping the $3.63M consensus estimate, as LCM rare earth separation scaled faster than modeled. The company confirmed Stillwater Phase 1A commissioning, announced a $2.8B acquisition of Serra Verde in Brazil, and flagged potential access to $1.6B in CHIPS Act funding — all while the stock sits 113% above its January open.

headline: PERU DECLARES Energy Emergency: Silver SPIKES 7% as 14% of Global Supply Faces Production Risk
snippet: Emergency Decree No. 003-2026 issued May 11 triggered an immediate 7.07% spike in spot silver to $86/oz as markets priced in supply risk from Peru — the world's second-largest silver producer at 14% of global output. Small and mid-tier operations with tight margins face the highest risk of temporary shutdowns as the energy crisis hits processing infrastructure and logistics.

headline: ISOENERGY Hits 11.6% U3O8 Over 1m at Hurricane South; 8,000m Summer Follow-Up Planned in Athabasca
snippet: IsoEnergy (TSX: ISO) confirmed 4.21% U3O8 over 3.5m — including a 11.6% grade peak over 1.0m — on the newly interpreted Hurricane South Trend at Larocque East in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin. Mineralization remains open in multiple directions beyond the current resource footprint, with an approximately 8,000m summer drill program across 20 holes now planned to test the highly prospective trend.

headline: BRIXTON METALS Drills 594 g/t Silver Across 13m — Peak 7,900 g/t — at Historic Ontario Silver Camp
snippet: Brixton Metals (TSX-V: BBB) returned 594 g/t silver over 13.0m — including a 7,900 g/t peak over 0.5m — from hole LM-26-350 at the S6-SE zone of its Langis Silver Project in Cobalt, Ontario. The result confirms a meaningful expansion of the historic Cobalt silver camp beyond known mineralization, with a maiden resource estimate targeted from 60,000m of planned 2026 drilling now approaching 14,000m completed.

headline: NEVADA JUNIOR NevGold Targets Maiden Antimony-Gold MRE With C$42M Funded as China Ban Exposes US Defense Gap
snippet: NevGold Corp. (TSXV: NAU) heads into its Q2 2026 maiden antimony-gold NI 43-101 MRE at Limousine Butte, Nevada, fully funded with C$42.2M in the treasury. The company is targeting near-term domestic antimony production from historical leach pads — key to US missile and munitions supply chains — as China's export restrictions leave US defense procurement with no near-term substitute.

headline: OMAI GOLD Drills 3.86 g/t Au Over 23.8m at Wenot — Guyana Bulk-Tonnage Project Targets PEA in Q3 2026
snippet: Omai Gold Mines (TSX-V: OMG) reported seven drill holes from its 50,000m program at Wenot in Guyana, including 3.86 g/t Au over 23.8m and 3.49 g/t Au over 16.9m. Multiple zones of gold mineralization were intersected in each hole as the company advances towards a preliminary economic assessment in early Q3 2026.

headline: Heraeus: Silver Producers Set for Strong 2026 Output, India Import Risk a Growing Supply-Chain Wildcard
snippet: Precious metals refiner and analyst Heraeus projects robust silver producer output in 2026 and flagged India's escalating import barriers days before the official tariff hike announcement. The analysis provides an independent supply-side counterpoint to Peru's energy-crisis disruption — globally, primary silver supply is healthy; the risk is demand destruction from policy, not output.

headline: 1911 GOLD Confirms L10 Zone Extends 160m Down-Plunge at True North: 11.54 g/t Over 3.7m at 720m Depth
snippet: 1911 Gold (TSX-V: AUMB) confirmed down-plunge and along-strike extensions of the L10 Zone at True North in southeastern Manitoba, with highlights of 11.54 g/t Au over 3.70m — including 30.7 g/t over 0.6m — from Level 16 at approximately 720m below surface. Drilling across 12 holes totaling 3,608m has potentially grown the zone 160m down-plunge within a 50,000m 2026 underground drill program.
